2057824933.title: Love to Dream Swaddle UP Transition Bag Original 1.0 TOG (4 Designs, 3 Sizes)
2057824933.detail_text: The SWADDLE UP™ TRANSITION BAG 1.0 TOG (previously known as Swaddle Up 50/50) is the easiest & gentlest way to help your baby graduate from swaddling. It enables you to zip off one wing at a time, allowing your baby to slowly adjust to ‘arms-free’ sleep. A genius solution that will help you preserve your peaceful sleep routine. The SWADDLE UP™ TRANSITION BAG ORIGINAL 1.0 TOG is made from a single layer of specially knitted, high-quality, breathable cotton. The 1.0 TOG fabric is ideal for moderate temperatures. Features: - 1.0 TOG fabric is ideal for moderate temperatures - Ideal for room temperatures between 20°C and 24°C - Gentler way to help your baby graduate from swaddling - Patented zip-off wings - Converts to a snug sleeping bag, maintaining the secure feeling of being swaddled - Single layer of fabric to reduce risk of overheating - Certified ‘hip-healthy’ design allows the recommended flexion for hips & legs - Twin zipper for easy nappy changes - No loose layers to kick off during sleep - Proudly supporting First Candle & SIDS research - Easy care: Machine washable & tumble dryer friendly. -Material: 93% Cotton, 7% Elastane

product.desc:
The SWADDLE UP™ TRANSITION BAG 1.0 TOG (previously known as Swaddle Up 50/50) is the easiest & gentlest way to help your baby graduate from swaddling. It enables you to zip off one wing at a time, allowing your baby to slowly adjust to ‘arms-free’ sleep. A genius solution that will help you preserve your peaceful sleep routine. The SWADDLE UP™ TRANSITION BAG ORIGINAL 1.0 TOG is made from a single layer of specially knitted, high-quality, breathable cotton. The 1.0 TOG fabric is ideal for moderate temperatures.

Features:

- 1.0 TOG fabric is ideal for moderate temperatures

- Ideal for room temperatures between 20°C and 24°C

- Gentler way to help your baby graduate from swaddling

- Patented zip-off wings

- Converts to a snug sleeping bag, maintaining the secure feeling of being swaddled

- Single layer of fabric to reduce risk of overheating

- Certified ‘hip-healthy’ design allows the recommended flexion for hips & legs

- Twin zipper for easy nappy changes

- No loose layers to kick off during sleep

- Proudly supporting First Candle & SIDS research

- Easy care: Machine washable & tumble dryer friendly.

-Material: 93% Cotton, 7% Elastane

Patented zip-off wings

Machine washable

3509546081.detail_html:
Effortlessly transition from any swaddle with the innovative Love to Dream™ transition bag, maintaining that snug, secure feeling your baby loves. This bag is 0.2 TOG, ideal for 24°C to 27°C.

Features & Benefits

  • Gentler way to help your baby graduate from swaddling
  • Specially designed with a wider fit at the bottom so that it can be worn over a hip dysplasia harness or brace
  • Patented zip-off wings
  • Converts to a snug sleeping bag, maintaining the secure feeling of being swaddled
  • Acknowledged as a hip-healthy product by the International Hip Dysplasia Institute; design allows the recommended flexion for hips & legs
  • Twin zipper for easy nappy changes
  • Single layer of fabric to reduce risk of overheating
  • No loose layers to kick off during sleep
  • Fabric content: 93% Cotton, 7% Elastane
  • Easy care: machine washable & tumble dryer friendly

Care Instructions

  • Wash before first use
  • Close zipper before washing
  • Warm gentle machine wash in wash bag with similar colours
  • Pull into shape after washing, before tumble drying/line drying
  • Tumble dry on low
  • Any warm or extra warm garments – tumble dry inside out on second cycle for quicker drying
  • Warm iron if necessary
  • Wash immediately after every use
  • Do not soak or bleach garment, iron zip or dry clean
  • Dark printed colors may fade or change after washing. This does not compromise the quality or comfort of our products.

What's in the box

  • 1x Love To Dream Swaddle UP Transition Bag Lite 0.2 TOG Breton Stripe Tan

Temperature Information

Finding the right TOG rating and dressing your baby appropriately for the temperature can be confusing. Every baby feels hot and cold differently, ambient temperatures fluctuate, and layering impacts thermal effectiveness. It's not a one-size-fits-all approach, but understanding these factors can help.

At Love to Dream we use the industry-recognised measurement system, called TOG. TOG stands for Thermal Overall Grade and helps simplify the process of choosing the right garment/s for your baby. Put simply: The lower the TOG rating, the lighter the fabric. The higher the TOG rating, the warmer the fabric.

The table below provides with guidelines around how to dress your baby/toddler based on the room temperature. It is only a guide. All babies are different. The number of clothing layers may vary according to a baby’s health, their physiology, and the room temperature in the room. The caregiver must determine what is suitable. We recommend that carers always monitor the temperature of the room & the child’s comfort. It is important to check your baby regularly to ensure that they are comfortable and that they do not overheat.

3583770171.detail_text: The Lollibly Organic Bamboo Swaddle Bag is designed to bring comfort and calm to your baby’s sleep, helping your baby sleep soundly and comfortably through the night. Designed for daily wear, the ultra-soft, breathable bamboo fabric naturally regulates temperature — keeping your baby snug yet cool, even in Singapore's warm, humid, tropical climate. Hypoallergenic and naturally antibacterial, this OEKO-TEX® certified fabric is gentle on delicate skin, providing safe and soothing comfort for every wear. With comfort and practicality in mind, the swaddle features an arms-up curvature that allows babies to sleep in their natural position and self-soothe, while the optimum curvature provides a secure, womb-like fit that encourages deeper sleep. The snug design ensures no rewrapping is needed throughout the night, and the wide leg area supports healthy hip development. For parents, a two-way zipper makes diaper changes quick and easy, even during the quiet hours. Brand: Lollibly Material: 95% Organic Bamboo, 5% Spandex⁣ Care Guide: Machine wash cold, dry in shade, do not bleach, do not use softener, do not use dryer

Easy to Use With its user-friendly design, the sleep bag is easy to put on and take off, making it convenient for both parents and babies.

product.desc:
Seasonal Versatility



This sleep bag is suitable for use throughout the year, making it an essential item for parents regardless of the season.






Suitable for Newborns



Specifically designed for newborns, this sleep bag ensures your baby gets the best possible start in life.






Safety Feature



The sleep bag features a unique design that helps prevent your baby from kicking off the covers, ensuring they stay warm and cozy throughout the night.






Ergonomic Design



The ergobag sleep bag is designed to provide comfort and support for your baby, reducing the risk of sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).






Easy to Use



With its user-friendly design, the sleep bag is easy to put on and take off, making it convenient for both parents and babies.

product.desc:
🍼 HOMIE Newborn Baby Bamboo Button Swaddle Sleeping Bag 【S(0-3M) • M(3-6M) • L(6-12M) 】

Stretchable • Breathable • Two-Way Zipper

Wrap your little one in pure comfort with the HOMIE Bamboo Button Swaddle Sleeping Bag! 🌿 Thoughtfully designed for babies aged 0–12 months, this ultra-soft sleeping bag mimics your baby's natural sleeping position with arms up — helping them sleep longer and safer. 😴💤

Features & Benefits:

👶 Arms-Up Design：Supports a natural sleeping posture, allowing babies to self-soothe by sucking on their hands — for more peaceful nights.

🌿 Bamboo Fabric (95% Bamboo + 5% Spandex)：Super soft, breathable, and stretchable — ideal for delicate newborn skin. Keeps baby cool in summer and warm in winter.

🔁 Two-Way Zipper：Makes midnight diaper changes a breeze — open from the top or bottom without fully removing the swaddle! 🚼✨

🎐 Button Swaddle Closure：Simple button design for quick swaddling and a secure fit, keeping baby snug and safe.

🫧 Gentle on Skin：Hypoallergenic and antibacterial bamboo fabric reduces irritation and keeps baby fresh and dry.

🎁 Perfect Baby Shower Gift：Stylish, functional, and essential — every new parent needs one!

Give your baby the safest and coziest sleep with HOMIE 💖

Because better sleep = happier baby & happier parents! 🌙👩‍🍼👨‍🍼

⚠️️Product images are for illustrative purposes only and may differ from the actual product due to differences in monitors, and hand-made processes and the colors of products may also appear different from those shown on the product link. Variation 1-3cm in error range. We advise strict parental supervision for all our products. You understand and acknowledge that by purchasing products for children, it is the responsibility of the parent/s legal guardian/s of the child to determine the appropriate and suitable products for their child.

3502887667.detail_html:
DreamKidz

Aube Arms-Out Swaddle

Signature Air Bamboo™

The Ideal Transition from Swaddle to Independent Sleep

Open Sleeveless Arms Out Swaddle Sleeping Bag to help your baby sleep soundly and safely as they begin to roll and explore new movements.

Crafted with extra legroom and a breathable open-sleeve design, it’s also the perfect wearable blanket for Singapore’s warm, humid weather.

Key Features

  • Sleeveless, Arms-Free Design - Supports natural arm movement while keeping your baby cool, comfortable, and safe as they start to roll.
  • Roomy Leg Area for Movement - Extra wide and long at the bottom, allowing your baby to stretch, roll, and sleep in the healthy frog-leg position — supporting hip development.
  • Comfortable, Secure Torso Fit - Snug around the chest to mimic the feeling of being swaddled — promoting calm and restful sleep.
  • Two-Way Zipper - Makes nighttime diaper changes quick and easy with minimal disturbance.
  • Wearable Blanket Alternative - Use over pajamas for a safe, cozy sleep solution that can’t be kicked off during the night.
  • Crafted for Singapore’s Climate - Made with our Signature Air Bamboo™ blend — breathable, lightweight, and gentle on sensitive skin.

Size Guide

Large (74 x 26 cm) – Recommended for babies 6 months and up

Available in one color only - Oat

Why Choose Signature Air Bamboo™?

  • Ideal for room temperatures between 20°C – 24°C
  • Hypoallergenic comfort for delicate baby skin
  • Thermo-regulating & moisture-wicking
  • Guaranteed softness, breathability, and stretchability
  • Naturally antibacterial & antifungal
  • Durable and long-lasting fabric
  • Natural UV-resistant properties
  • Sustainably sourced, responsibly made

Material:

  • Bamboo Lyocell – an eco-friendly bamboo fabric renowned for its gentle manufacturing process and minimal environmental footprint.
  • Premium crafted blend: 95% Bamboo Lyocell and 5% Spandex for superior comfort and stretch.

Certifications:

  • Global Recycled Standard

Pro tip for parents:

Adjust the child's clothing layers based on their temperature and the room temperature. The caregiver needs to decide what's appropriate

product.desc:
Tommee Tippee The Original Grobag Sleeping Bag Sleepbag Sleepee Snuggee Steppee Snuggle

New in original packaging

Colours: Abstract Animal, Abstract Rainbow (Sleepbag, Steppee), Botanical, Blush, Capri Zig Zag, Navy Speckle, Ollie the Owl, Pink Marl (sleepee snuggee), Pink Petal, Sky Grey Marl (Sleepbag, Snuggle, Steppee), Sleeping Ollie, Sleeping Pip, Woodlands Grofriends

Sizes available in:

0-4m (3.17-6.12kg, 51-62cm)

3-9m (5.44-8.68kg, 60-72cm)

6-18m (8.16-11.34kg, 65-80cm)

18-36m (11.34 kg upwards, to 53.5cm chest, 80-95cm)

TOG Rating

- 0.2 TOG (warmth rating): ideal for heatwaves, hot weather and very warm rooms with temperatures above 24°C.

- 1.0 TOG (warmth rating): ideal for use in warmer months or in rooms with temperatures between 20-24°C.

This sleep bag is made from super-soft, cotton-rich, fluorescent-free fabric that’s soft and gentle on baby’s skin and perfect for a comfortable night’s sleep.

Our sleep bags have been designed to be snug up top and wriggly down below - slim fitting through the chest to enable full freedom of movement without restriction or excess bulk with a roomy, hip-healthy bottom.

With accurate TOG ratings our sleep bags will help keep your baby at the right temperature no matter how much they wriggle about.

product.desc:
Brand

Miracle Baby

Fabric

100% knitted cotton

Function

Eco-friendly, Machine washable, Breathable

Size

Small: 0-3 months, 3 to 6kg or 7 to 14 lbs, 50x75cm Large: 3-6 months, 6 to 9kg or 14 to 20 lbs, 60x75cm

Hat: Suitable for head circumference 36-48cm

Color

3 colors per set; Please order in multiples of 3 pcs(1 set).

Design

The swaddle wrap recreates a womb like feeling that helps your baby to fall sleep, and stay asleep, by preventing the startle reflex. Adjustable Velcro Flaps for the Perfect Fit.

Gift

Our velcro swaddling wrap blankets are perfect for babies 7-14 pounds and are adjustable for the perfect fit. This sleep sack set makes the best unisex infant, baby shower gift for boys and girls!

Styles

Soft fabric wings fasten and readjust securely with hook and loop attachments to create a perfect fit.

Details Images

Carefully selected high-quality cotton

Just for the baby to be more comfortable

page_json.description: <html> <head></head> <body>  Pure Cotton Material   Crafted from pure cotton, this baby sleep bag offers a soft and comfortable experience for your little one, ensuring a good night's sleep.    Seasonal Versatility   This sleep bag is designed to be used throughout the year, making it a versatile addition to your baby's wardrobe.    Newborn Compatibility   Specifically designed for newborns, this sleep bag provides the perfect blend of comfort and safety for your infant's delicate skin.    Anti-startle Design   The anti-startle design of this sleep bag helps prevent your baby from waking up due to sudden movements, promoting a peaceful sleep.    Prevents Kicking   The sleep bag's unique design effectively prevents your baby from kicking off the covers, ensuring they stay warm and cozy throughout the night.     </body></html>

product.desc:
Pictures:

Specification:

Brand: Miracle Baby

Applicable age: 0-12 months

Applicable scenarios: all scenarios

Brand:Miracle Baby

Fabric:100% knitted cotton

Function:Eco-friendly, Machine washable, Breathable

Size:

Small: 0-3 months, 3 to 6kg or 7 to 14 lbs, 50x75cm Large: 3-6 months, 6 to 9kg or 14 to 20 lbs, 60x75cm

Color:

3 colors per set

Design:

The swaddle wrap recreates a womb like feeling that helps your baby to fall sleep, and stay asleep, by preventing the startle reflex. Adjustable Velcro Flaps for the Perfect Fit.

Gift:

Our velcro swaddling wrap blankets are perfect for babies 7-14 pounds and are adjustable for the perfect fit. This sleep sack set makes the best unisex infant, baby shower gift for boys and girls!

Styles:

Soft fabric wings fasten and readjust securely with hook and loop attachments to create a perfect fit.

Feature:

Works as a stroller or nursing cover, changing pad cover, burp cloth, tummy time blanket and more.

Breathable&odorresistant: no bad odor after many days use;great for hot summer also can keep you warm in cool weather

product.desc: Product Features: 【Simulate the womb】Mimic the mothers' uterus. Bring a sense of security to your baby. Let the baby sleep well and sleep sweetly. 【Bamboo fiber fabric】Cool, soft and breathable material, taking care of the baby's delicate skin. 【2-way zipper design】Convenient for the mom to change diapers without wakening the baby. 【Expanded hem design】Provides enough spaces for the baby's hip development and leg extension. 【Shark-fin soothing sleeves】Soothing sleeves are safe for baby teething, meanwhile do not hinder the baby's activities.Specification: Category: swaddling sleeping bag Color: as the pictures showed Applicable age: newborn (0-1 year old) Thickness: thin Fabric: bamboo fiber Zipper texture: nylon Dimensions: S (0-3 months), M (3-6 months), L (6-9 months) Applicable seasons: summer, spring, autumnWashing Instruction: ️ Please clean it before first use! the softer the cotton cloth is washed.️ Wash with hot water below 40 degrees. Handwashing is recommended. To wash in the machine, please put it in the laundry bag.️ Do not bleach. Do not dry clean. Dry and don't expose to the sun.Notice:1. Please allow a reasonable color difference due to different displays & light.2. Please allow 1-2 cm dimension variation due to manual measurement.#babyswaddle #babyswaddling #babysleeping #babysleep #babywrapper #babysleepingbag #swaddlesleepingbag #swaddleblanket

13760079225.detail_text: Safety Feature The insular341B sleep bag is designed with a safety feature to prevent sudden movements from causing harm to your baby. Crossed Wrap Style The crossed wrap style of the sleep bag ensures that your baby remains snug and secure throughout the night. Magic Tape Design The magic tape design allows for easy wrapping and unwrapping, making it convenient for parents to use. Newborn Compatibility This sleep bag is perfect for newborns, providing them with a secure and comfortable environment for sleep. Stress Relief The sleep bag helps to relieve stress for both the baby and the parents, ensuring a good night's sleep for everyone.

product.desc:
Safety Feature



The insular341B sleep bag is designed with a safety feature to prevent sudden movements from causing harm to your baby.






Crossed Wrap Style



The crossed wrap style of the sleep bag ensures that your baby remains snug and secure throughout the night.






Magic Tape Design



The magic tape design allows for easy wrapping and unwrapping, making it convenient for parents to use.






Newborn Compatibility



This sleep bag is perfect for newborns, providing them with a secure and comfortable environment for sleep.






Stress Relief



The sleep bag helps to relieve stress for both the baby and the parents, ensuring a good night's sleep for everyone.

3509344458.detail_html:
Product details

  • Gentler way to help your baby graduate from swaddling
  • Patented zip-off wings
  • Converts to a snug sleeping bag, maintaining the secure feeling of being swaddled
  • Twin zipper for easy diaper changes
  • Acknowledged as a hip-healthy product by the International Hip Dysplasia Institute; design allows the recommended flexion for hips & legs
  • This 1.0 TOG Material is ideal for room temperatures between 68°F & 75°F
  • Single layer of fabric to reduce risk of overheating
  • No loose layers to kick off during sleep
  • Pairs perfectly with our Love to Dream™ layers for sleep and play
  • Easy care: machine washable & tumble dryer friendly
  • Available in 2 sizes: Medium & Large
  • Fabric content: 93% Cotton, 7% Elastane

 

Care Instructions

  • Wash before first use
  • Close zipper before washing
  • Warm gentle machine wash in wash bag with similar colours
  • Pull into shape after washing, before tumble drying/line drying
  • Tumble dry on low
  • Any warm or extra warm garments – tumble dry inside out on second cycle for quicker drying
  • Warm iron if necessary
  • Wash immediately after every use
  • Do not soak or bleach garment, iron zip or dry clean
  • Dark printed colors may fade or change after washing. This does not compromise the quality or comfort of our products.
